cards.title: How I Fight AI Brain Fry

depth.text: someone set up a **task queue** to keep **AI coding work** from **frying their focus**

Tickets are **Markdown files in the repo**, and an agent researches them, builds the ones marked safe, runs tests, and checks the browser. A Claude artifact shows the board for review; the **owner inbox** gathers decisions for the human, and production deployment stays with the author. The author handles **one item at a time**, then puts it back in the queue so its context doesn't keep occupying their memory.

cards.camps: Two camps: some say limit parallel tasks and focus on one thing; others use queues and tools to manage several agent tasks at once.
